Preview: 

Frame by frame animations! :D PNG, Atlas format.

Yet another version:

 - 4 animations of explosions.

 - Each Animation Atlas frame is a 512 x 512 size image (4096 x 4096 total). Included half sized version as well (2048 x 2048 total).

 - PNG format with transparency.

 

If you have comments on how we can improve these assets pls leave a comment :>

Oh yeah... and these are free so .... so there you go

HAVE FUN! and make awesome games :>
